verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment and calendar tools to any compatible client, and a probe confirms the MCP integration docs page exists. The server itself is clearly delivered, but the evidence is first-party only. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and documented connection/auth setup details in the evidence.
